subject: Next steps: Discovery -> Pilot commitment & kickoff prerequisites
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chu <alex@lumosai.com>
Cc: Maya Redd <maya.redd@lumosai.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Discovery -> Pilot commitment & kickoff prerequisites

Alex / Maya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed pilot plan so we have alignment before we lock dates. Notes below are intentionally concise; happy to expand any section.

Key pain points you reiterated:
- High inference cost on current stack when generating long-form outputs (monthly token spend spikes).
- Latency variability during peak batch jobs impacting product SLAs.
- Data residency requirement: US-only processing for certain customer subsets.

Primary goals for pilot (6 weeks):
1) Validate cost reduction levers (batching + KV cache) while keeping output quality within your defined thresholds. Target: >=30% cost reduction on the evaluated workload.
2) Confirm 95th-percentile generation latency under 200ms for single-turn chat and <350ms for 2–8k-context prompts on our dedicated config.
3) Demonstrate secure private routing for the regulated dataset subset (US region).

Proposed pilot scope (what Redwood will deliver):
- Load a representative prompt/eval set (you to provide sample prompts and 250 labeled outputs).
- Spin up a dedicated pilot workspace in US region with pre-configured batching and a recommended quantization profile.
- Run end-to-end evals (quality regression + latency/cost breakdown) and deliver a short report at week 3 and week 6.

Success metrics / acceptance criteria:
- Cost: >=30% reduction vs current baseline over a 48-hour sustained run.
- Quality: model pass-rate >=90% on the labeled eval set (precision at top-1 as defined in the attached sample-prompts.csv).
- Latency: 95th percentile below 200ms for single-turn and below 350ms for multi-turn average.

Owners / points of contact:
- Redwood AE / project lead: Kimberly Park (kimberly_park@redwood.com) — overall coordination, timeline, pricing
- Redwood infra / access: Dev Patel (dev_patel@redwood.com) — AWS role setup, keys, onboarding docs
- Lumos product: Alex Chu (alex@lumosai.com) — data/sample prompts, labeling clarifications
- Lumos security: Maya Redd (maya.redd@lumosai.com) — compliance questions, SOC2 evidence requests

Pilot timeline (tentative):
- Week 0 (this week): paperwork + access — procurement paperwork in parallel, provide sample prompts and 250 labeled outputs
- Week 1: Workspace setup + sample data ingest + smoke tests
- Week 2–3: Run initial evals, adjust batching/quantization, deliver mid-point report
- Week 4–5: Iterative tuning and run production-like sustained tests
- Week 6: Final report and handoff / recommendations for Dedicated or Hosted migration

Access / setup checklist we need from Lumos (items to action on your side):
- A short list of 3 representative user prompts + 250 labeled outputs (CSV) — deliver to the Drive link below
- AWS account role (ARN) or temporary S3 transfer details for dataset ingestion
- Procurement contact to start the SOW/PO cadence (we can accept basic purchase order or a short SOW)
- SOC2 / security questionnaire contact for early review (Maya suggested she will lead)

Attachments: pilot-charter-v1.pdf (charter + success metrics), sample-prompts.csv (format for labeled evals).

Proposed next steps (please pick options):
A) Confirm pilot acceptance + provide sample prompts and AWS role this week (we target kickoff Mon 3/7)
B) If procurement/security need more time, propose dates (we can shift kickoff to week of 3/14)

If that looks good, I’ll send a 1-page SOW and a calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff once we have access.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: pilot-charter-v1.pdf, sample-prompts.csv
From: Alex Chu <alex@lumosai.com>

Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Discovery -> Pilot commitment & kickoff prerequisites

Thanks Kim — that recap is super helpful and captures the constraints. We’re aligned on the goals. A few quick items from our side:

- Procurement will need a draft SOW and estimated cost for the 6-week pilot (ballpark is fine for now). Can you share a one-page SOW and an estimated monthly run-rate for the pilot config?
- Maya (cc) wants to see the SOC2 Type II report and data flow diagram before we start ingesting the regulated dataset. Can you drop those or point us to the security folder?
- We can produce the 250 labeled outputs but need to confirm format — the sample-prompts.csv looks like the right schema.
- Timeline: we’d prefer kickoff the week of 3/14 rather than 3/7 to give procurement a little lead time. Does that work on your end?

If you can send the SOW and security docs, we’ll start the procurement loop. I’ll also introduce our cloud ops engineer in a follow-up if we need help with the AWS role.

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Chu
Head of Product, Lumos AI
alex@lumosai.com | +1 (206) 555-0199

Avery / Dev — forwarding Alex’s reply. Procurement wants a one-page SOW + pilot cost estimate; security wants SOC2 and the data flow diagram before regulated data is moved. Alex prefers kickoff week of 3/14.

Can we do the following this week?
- Avery: draft a 1-page SOW and a conservative pilot cost estimate we can share with purchasing (include breakout: infra + support + milestone report).
- Dev: prep a short onboarding packet (redwood-onboarding-instructions.pdf) and a Drive folder with the SOC2 link + data flow diagram (we can point them to the security folder). Also confirm whether we can accept temporary S3 upload or need an assumed-role flow.

I’ll hold off on a kickoff invite until we confirm 3/14 is ok and procurement has the SOW. Please reply with status and estimates.

—
Kimberly
Senior Account Executive
